description: Use when an agent is about to send funds and must decide whether the destination is a plain wallet or a contract: returns isContract and the size of the deployed bytecode. A wallet where you expected a contract, or the reverse, is the cheapest mistake to catch before signing. Do not use to judge whether a token is safe (/v1/evm/token-safety) or worth trusting (/v1/evm/verdict). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_is_contract
title: Contract or wallet
